_catatan: setting.json — disajikan sebagai native_setting (XOR DragonBall on-the-fly) untuk EntryPoint /lzceshi/native_setting/Android dan /bs/db/android/setting_BS_Android.bin. KONTRAK CLIENT: Application native baca EntryPoint1 (base64 di assets/config.properties) -> GET native_setting -> decode XOR -> url = shell game (index-native.html, mode nativeRender=1), loginServer+loginPort dikirim ke JS via ExternalInterface 'startGame' (shell window.getLoginServer), CurrentMode WAJIB != 0 (0 = popup check_network), versionbin 110/11220 = persis assets APK (Egret tidak download).
